g.title: dRTA_QSP
g.text: Distal Renal Tubular Acidosis — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
177 nodes · 19 clusters · companion to drta_mrgsolve_model.R (56 ODEs) and drta_shiny_app.R (10 tabs)

g.title: cluster_gene
g.text: 1 · AETIOLOGY — the lesion enters the model as two numbers only
(rate defect) · LES_grad = retained maximal blood→urine ΔpH (gradient defect)

g.title: cluster_bic
g.text: 3 · β-INTERCALATED CELL — base secretion, the wrong-way valve

g.title: cluster_pt
g.text: 4 · PROXIMAL TUBULE — buffer supply and the citrate valve

g.title: cluster_ctrl
g.text: 5 · THE CONTROL LOOP — integral control with a saturating actuator
dRTA is the SATURATION of this loop, not a missing pathway

g.title: cluster_urine
g.text: 6 · LUMINAL PROTON BALANCE — urine pH is SOLVED, not fitted
J_H(pH_u) = ΔHCO₃⁻ delivered + titratable acid + NH₄⁺ trapped + citrate protonated

g.title: cluster_sink1
g.text: 7 · SINK 1 — ECF bicarbonate (MINUTES). The only sink that is measured.

g.title: cluster_sink3
g.text: 9 · SINK 3 — BONE CARBONATE (YEARS). Where the unmet gap actually goes.
RECTIFIED in pH ⇒ CONVEX ⇒ a spiky HCO₃⁻ profile costs more bone than a flat one of the same MEAN (Jensen)

g.title: cluster_cit
g.text: 11 · CITRATE — the Tm-limited valve that makes bolus dosing GOOD

g.title: cluster_stone
g.text: 12 · CRYSTALLISATION — why dRTA makes CALCIUM-PHOSPHATE stones
the one acidosis whose urine is ALKALINE: high Ca²⁺ × high HPO₄²⁻ × low citrate

g.title: cluster_ckd
g.text: 13 · THE VICIOUS LOOP — a tubular disease that ends as CKD
> 80 % of ADULT dRTA patients have KDIGO stage ≥ 2 (B22CS)

g.title: cluster_pk
g.text: 14 · ALKALI PHARMACOKINETICS — the DELIVERY RATE is the active variable

g.title: cluster_rate
g.text: 15 · RATE MATCHING — where a bolus of alkali is actually lost
the waste bites hardest AT the therapeutic target, so the RESPONDER RATE moves far more than the MEAN

g.title: cluster_opp
g.text: 16 · THE TWO ENDPOINTS WANT OPPOSITE KINETICS

g.title: cluster_k
g.text: 17 · POTASSIUM — the H⁺-pump lesion IS a K⁺-wasting lesion
plasma K⁺ is a ratio too: ~300 mmol of deficit per mmol/L

g.title: SATURATED
g.text: In COMPLETE dRTA the urine-pH arm

g.title: INCOMPL
g.text: the actuator is ALREADY railed at a normal acid load,
so plasma HCO₃⁻ is normal, the acid-load test fails,
and the bone / citrate flux is

g.title: RESPRATE
g.text: moves much more than the mean

g.title: MONITOR
g.text: total CO₂ q3–4 months in infants

g.title: DISSOC
g.text: same patient, same visit, same lesion

g.title: PHTRADE
g.text: alkali RAISES urine pH (bad for CaP)

g.title: TWOGRAN
g.text: is the only schedule that does both

g.title: BICWASTE
g.text: the dose leaves in the urine

g.title: HEADROOM
g.text: CaP stone formers urine pH still has
